articles.title: McNulty Shocks the Cycling World with 'Miracle' World Championship Win
articles.summary: Brandon McNulty became the first American since 1993 to win cycling's elite road race world title, attacking with 33 km left in Montreal and holding on for a 13-second victory.

articles.title: Teen's Plant-Based Plastic Could Help Clean Up Microplastic Pollution
articles.summary: 18-year-old Arya Satheesh invented Eco Purge, a bioplastic that decomposes while breaking down microplastics. Her project won a European science prize and $12,500 in funding.

articles.title: 13-Year-Old Yu Zidi Storms to Third Gold — and a New Asian Games Record
articles.summary: Yu Zidi, just 13, won her third gold at the Asian Games in Nagoya by crushing the 400m individual medley record. Her time of 4:28.56 beat the old mark by nearly 4.5 seconds — and only one woman in the world has swum faster this year.
